title: Pre-Push Orphan GC Quarantine (full mark-and-sweep) howto
desc: T2 howto for the pre-push orphan GC-quarantine guard: edge extraction per language, bounded-3-hop BFS algorithm, over-mark bias, sweep+notify impl, dry-run rollout, build flow.
steps: EDGE EXTRACTION per extension: ps1 = dot-source lines + Import-Module + -File args; cs = csproj Compile Include + project membership; py = import and from; sh = source and dot; js and ts = import and require; generic = path-like string literals. Output a directed file-to-file graph.
ALGORITHM: BFS or DFS from the root set; visited-set for cycle safety (A to B to A); depth cap about 3 hops (bounded, NOT full fixpoint -- recoverable so approximate is fine).
OVER-MARK BIAS in code: when a token MIGHT be a path or reference, ADD the edge. Prefer keeping a file over quarantining it. Never under-mark.
SWEEP impl: for each unmarked file, Move-Item to .tmp/unused-DATE/ preserving relative path; create the dated dir; skip .git and existing .tmp; MOVE not delete.
NOTIFY impl: write one friendly stderr block listing moved files + the .tmp/unused-DATE/ recovery path; then exit 0 (never block the push).
ROLLOUT: implement a -DryRun switch that LISTS candidates and moves nothing; ship dry-run first, calibrate on real repos, flip to live-move only after the candidate list is verified accurate.
BUILD FLOW: haiku prototypes in a -proto sandbox; sonnet architects and implements; ROOT verifies synthetic + live + static then merges and wires the pre-push hook.

requirements.cmd: dry-run on a repo with an orphan file
